app.name: Cron Builder
app.description: Build and check cron schedules: a visual builder, plain-language descriptions, next runs in any time zone, and systemd and EveryOS forms.

problems.field-count: A cron expression has {{count}} fields separated by spaces (found {{token}}).
problems.bad-token: {{field}}: “{{token}}” is not a number, a name, * or a list.
problems.bad-step: {{field}}: the step in “{{token}}” must be a number above 0.
problems.reboot: @reboot runs at startup, not at a time: there are no run times to show.

builder.custom: Edit this field in the expression (it uses a form the builder does not show).

runs.none: This schedule never runs (for example 30 February).
runs.invalid: Fix the expression to see run times.

export.title: Use it
export.twoLines: Cron runs when either day field matches; systemd needs both, so the timer gets two lines.

problems.seconds: Scheduled Tasks have no seconds field.
problems.too-frequent: Scheduled Tasks run at most every 5 minutes (12 times an hour).

export.notScheduled: Cron Builder only builds expressions: it never schedules anything on this server.
